title: The Book of Ecclesiastes Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Ecclesiastes — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: These are the sayings of the Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
verses.decoded: Everything is meaningless, says the Teacher—completely meaningless.

verses.kjv: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
verses.decoded: What benefit does a person get from all their hard work here on earth?

verses.kjv: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
verses.decoded: One generation dies and another is born, but the earth remains forever.

verses.kjv: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
verses.decoded: The sun rises and sets, then rushes back to where it rises again.

verses.kjv: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
verses.decoded: The wind blows south, then turns north, swirling endlessly in its path.

verses.kjv: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
verses.decoded: Rivers flow into the sea, but the sea never fills up; the water keeps returning to where it started.

verses.kjv: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
verses.decoded: Everything is full of endless activity; people can’t express it all. The eyes never get enough of seeing, nor the ears of hearing.

verses.kjv: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
verses.decoded: What has happened before will happen again; what has been done will be done again. There is nothing truly new in this world.

verses.kjv: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
verses.decoded: Is there anything people can call new? It has all happened long ago, before us.

verses.kjv: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
verses.decoded: People forget the past, and those who come later will forget the future too.

verses.kjv: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: I, the Teacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
verses.decoded: I devoted myself to studying and understanding everything done on earth. God has made this a difficult task for humans to deal with.

verses.kjv: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: I have seen everything people do on earth, and it’s all meaningless and frustrating.

verses.kjv: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
verses.decoded: What is twisted cannot be made straight, and what is missing cannot be counted.

verses.kjv: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.decoded: I reflected deeply and said to myself, 'Look, I have become very powerful and have gained more wisdom than anyone who lived in Jerusalem before me. My heart has experienced much wisdom and knowledge.'

verses.kjv: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: I dedicated myself to understanding wisdom, as well as madness and foolishness, and I realized that this too is frustrating and troubling to the spirit.

verses.kjv: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
verses.decoded: Because with great wisdom comes much sadness, and increasing knowledge brings more sorrow.

verses.kjv: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
verses.decoded: I decided to test myself with happiness and enjoy pleasures, but I realized that this too is meaningless.

verses.kjv: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
verses.decoded: I thought about laughter and concluded it is foolish; and I wondered what real value joy has.

verses.kjv: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
verses.decoded: I decided to indulge in wine while still keeping my mind wise, and to embrace foolishness for a time, to discover what is truly good for people to do during their lives.

verses.kjv: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
verses.decoded: I accomplished great projects, built houses, and planted vineyards for myself.

verses.kjv: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
verses.decoded: I created gardens and orchards, planting all kinds of fruit trees.

verses.kjv: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
verses.decoded: I built pools of water to irrigate the trees that bear fruit.

verses.kjv: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
verses.decoded: I acquired servants and maidservants, and even had servants born in my household; I owned more livestock than anyone else in Jerusalem before me.

verses.kjv: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
verses.decoded: I collected silver and gold, treasures from kings and provinces; I also got male and female singers and all kinds of musical instruments to enjoy human pleasures.

verses.kjv: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
verses.decoded: I became greater and more successful than anyone before me in Jerusalem, and I still kept my wisdom.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
verses.decoded: I did not deny myself anything my eyes wanted; I did not hold back my heart from any pleasure. My heart enjoyed all my hard work, and this was my reward for all my efforts.

verses.kjv: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
verses.decoded: But when I looked at everything I had done and all the hard work I had put in, I saw that it was all meaningless and frustrating, with no real benefit in life.

verses.kjv: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
verses.decoded: So I considered wisdom, madness, and foolishness, realizing that anyone who comes after the king will do the same things that have already been done.

verses.kjv: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
verses.decoded: I realized that wisdom is far better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.

verses.kjv: The wise man’s eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
verses.decoded: A wise person sees clearly, but a fool walks in darkness. Yet I noticed that the same fate happens to both.

verses.kjv: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
verses.decoded: I thought to myself, what happens to the fool also happens to me, so why am I any wiser? Then I concluded that this too is meaningless.

verses.kjv: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
verses.decoded: No one remembers the wise any more than the fool forever, because everything that exists now will be forgotten in the future. And the wise person dies just like the fool.

verses.kjv: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I came to hate life, since all the work done here on earth troubles me; everything is meaningless and causes frustration.

verses.kjv: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
verses.decoded: I even hated all the hard work I did on earth because I will have to leave it to someone else after I’m gone.

verses.kjv: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
verses.decoded: And no one knows if the person who inherits my work will be wise or foolish, yet they will control everything I worked hard for and showed wisdom in. This too is meaningless.

verses.kjv: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
verses.decoded: So I decided to give up hope about all the hard work I did on earth.

verses.kjv: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
verses.decoded: There is a person who works wisely, knowledgeably, and fairly, but still has to leave everything to someone who didn’t work for it. This is meaningless and very unfair.

verses.kjv: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
verses.decoded: What does a person gain from all their hard work and the worries they have while working on earth?

verses.kjv: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
verses.decoded: All their days are filled with pain and grief, and their mind doesn’t find rest even at night. This too is meaningless.

verses.kjv: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
verses.decoded: The best thing a person can do is to eat, drink, and enjoy the good results of their work. I realized this pleasure comes as a gift from God.

verses.kjv: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
verses.decoded: Who else can enjoy eating and drinking more than I can?

verses.kjv: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy to those who please Him, but gives hard work to sinners to collect wealth and give it to the righteous. This too is meaningless and frustrating.

verses.kjv: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.decoded: There is a right time for everything, and a specific time for every activity under the sky.

verses.kjv: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.decoded: There is a time to be born and a time to die; a time to plant crops and a time to harvest them.

verses.kjv: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.decoded: There is a time to kill and a time to heal; a time to tear down and a time to build up.

verses.kjv: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.decoded: There is a time to cry and a time to laugh; a time to grieve and a time to celebrate.

verses.kjv: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.decoded: There is a time to throw away stones and a time to gather them; a time to hug and a time to hold back from hugging.

verses.kjv: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.decoded: There is a time to gain and a time to lose; a time to keep things and a time to discard them.

verses.kjv: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.decoded: There is a time to tear apart and a time to mend; a time to be silent and a time to speak.

verses.kjv: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
verses.decoded: There is a time to love and a time to hate; a time for war and a time for peace.

verses.kjv: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
verses.decoded: What benefit does a person get from all the hard work they do?

verses.kjv: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
verses.decoded: I have observed the hard work and challenges that God has assigned to people to experience.

verses.kjv: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verses.decoded: God has made everything beautiful at the right time, and has placed a sense of eternity in people's hearts, but no one can fully understand God's complete plan from start to finish.

verses.kjv: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
verses.decoded: I realize that the best thing people can do is to enjoy life and do good while they live.

verses.kjv: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
verses.decoded: Everyone should eat, drink, and enjoy the results of their work, because this is a gift from God.

verses.kjv: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
verses.decoded: I understand that whatever God does lasts forever; nothing can be added or taken away from it. God does this so that people will respect and reverence Him.

verses.kjv: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
verses.decoded: What has happened before is happening now, and what will happen in the future has already happened; God calls back the past.

verses.kjv: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
verses.decoded: I also observed here on earth that places meant for justice were filled with evil, and places meant for fairness were filled with wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.decoded: I thought to myself that God will judge both good and evil people, because there is a right time for everything and every action.

verses.kjv: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
verses.decoded: I considered human life and thought that God might reveal the truth to them so they would realize they are no better than animals.

verses.kjv: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
verses.decoded: What happens to people also happens to animals: they both die, and they all share the same breath. Humans have no advantage over animals; everything is meaningless.

verses.kjv: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.decoded: Everyone goes to the same place after death; we all come from dust and return to dust.

verses.kjv: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
verses.decoded: Who can understand the spirit of a person that rises upward, or the spirit of an animal that goes down into the earth?

verses.kjv: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
verses.decoded: So I realize that the best thing a person can do is to enjoy their own work, because that is their reward. No one knows what will happen after they die.

verses.kjv: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
verses.decoded: I looked again at all the oppression happening in the world. I saw the tears of those who were oppressed, but they had no one to comfort them. Meanwhile, the oppressors had power, but they also had no one to comfort them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I said that those who have already died are better off than those who are still alive.

verses.kjv: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.decoded: Even better than both the living and the dead is the person who has not yet been born and has not seen the evil done in the world.

verses.kjv: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: I also thought about all hard work and every good deed, and realized that people are often envied by their neighbors because of it. This, too, is meaningless and causes frustration.

verses.kjv: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
verses.decoded: A lazy person just folds their hands and destroys themselves by doing nothing.

verses.kjv: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: It is better to have a little with peace than to have a lot with constant stress and worry.

verses.kjv: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
verses.decoded: Again, I looked and saw that everything is meaningless in this world.

verses.kjv: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
verses.decoded: There is a person who is all alone, with no children or siblings. Yet, they keep working endlessly, never satisfied with their wealth. They don’t even ask themselves, 'Why am I working so hard and depriving myself of enjoyment?' This is also meaningless and a heavy burden.

verses.kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
verses.decoded: Two people working together are better than one, because they get a better return for their effort.

verses.kjv: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
verses.decoded: If one person falls, the other can help them up. But if someone is alone and falls, there’s no one to help them.

verses.kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
verses.decoded: If two people sleep close together, they keep each other warm, but one alone can’t stay warm by themselves.

verses.kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.decoded: If one person attacks, two can defend themselves. And a cord made of three strands is very strong and hard to break.

verses.kjv: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
verses.decoded: It is better to be a poor but wise young person than an old and foolish king who refuses to listen to advice.

verses.kjv: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
verses.decoded: One who was once imprisoned becomes king, while someone born into royalty becomes poor.

verses.kjv: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
verses.decoded: I thought about all the people alive today and the fact that a second child will take the place of the first.

verses.kjv: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: There is no limit to the number of people, including all who lived before them; those who come later will not find joy in him either. Truly, this is meaningless and causes frustration.

verses.kjv: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
verses.decoded: Be careful and respectful when you go to God's house; be eager to listen rather than to offer foolish sacrifices, because those who do so do not realize they are doing wrong.

verses.kjv: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
verses.decoded: Don't speak carelessly or quickly when you are before God; remember that God is in heaven and you are on earth, so keep your words few and thoughtful.

verses.kjv: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool’s voice is known by multitude of words.
verses.decoded: Dreams often come from too much activity, and a fool can be recognized by how many words he speaks.

verses.kjv: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
verses.decoded: If you make a vow to God, don't delay fulfilling it; God has no pleasure in fools, so keep your promises.

verses.kjv: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
verses.decoded: It's better not to make a vow at all than to make one and then fail to keep it.

verses.kjv: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
verses.decoded: Don't let your words lead you into sin, and don't claim before angels that it was a mistake; why should God be angry with your words and ruin what you have done?

verses.kjv: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
verses.decoded: Many dreams and many words lead to emptiness and meaningless things; instead, fear God.

verses.kjv: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
verses.decoded: If you see the poor oppressed and justice twisted in a region, don't be surprised; the one who is above all watches, and there are others even higher than those in power.

verses.kjv: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
verses.decoded: The earth's resources benefit everyone, even the king depends on the land's produce.

verses.kjv: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
verses.decoded: Those who love money will never be satisfied with money, and those who love wealth will never have enough; this too is meaningless.

verses.kjv: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
verses.decoded: As possessions grow, so do the number of people who consume them; what benefit does the owner really have except to look at them?

verses.kjv: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
verses.decoded: A hardworking person sleeps well, whether they have little or much to eat, but the rich often cannot sleep because of their abundance.

verses.kjv: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
verses.decoded: I have seen a terrible problem in life: wealth kept by its owners causes harm to them.

verses.kjv: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.
verses.decoded: That wealth is lost through misfortune, and when the owner has a son, he has nothing to give him.

verses.kjv: As he came forth of his mother’s womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
verses.decoded: Just as a person enters the world with nothing, he will leave with nothing and cannot take any of his work's gains with him.

verses.kjv: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
verses.decoded: This too is a serious problem: just as a person came into the world with nothing, so they will leave with nothing. What benefit is there for someone who works hard for something that ultimately amounts to nothing?

verses.kjv: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
verses.decoded: He spends all his days eating in sadness and experiences much pain and anger because of his illness.

verses.kjv: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
verses.decoded: Here is what I have observed: it is right and fitting for a person to eat, drink, and enjoy the results of all their hard work during the life God has given them, because that is their rightful share.

verses.kjv: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
verses.decoded: Anyone whom God has blessed with wealth and the ability to enjoy it and find satisfaction in their work has received a gift from God.

verses.kjv: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.
verses.decoded: Such a person does not dwell on the length of their life because God fills their heart with joy.

verses.kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:
verses.decoded: I have seen something bad happening in the world, and it happens to many people:

verses.kjv: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
verses.decoded: A person may be given wealth, riches, and honor by God, and want for nothing they desire, but still not be able to enjoy it because someone else benefits instead. This is meaningless and a terrible problem.

verses.kjv: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
verses.decoded: If a man has a hundred children and lives many years, but never finds satisfaction or a proper burial, it would be better to have died at birth.

verses.kjv: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
verses.decoded: He comes into the world empty-handed and leaves in darkness, and his name is forgotten.

verses.kjv: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
verses.decoded: Even a person who dies young without experiencing life has more rest than the one who lives long but without satisfaction.

verses.kjv: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
verses.decoded: Even if someone lives for two thousand years but never enjoys good things, in the end, everyone goes to the same place (death).

verses.kjv: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
verses.decoded: People work hard to satisfy their hunger, but they are never truly satisfied.

verses.kjv: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
verses.decoded: What advantage does the wise person have over the fool? What does the poor person gain by living rightly?

verses.kjv: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: It is better to see and enjoy what you have than to endlessly chase desires. But even this is meaningless and frustrating.

verses.kjv: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
verses.decoded: What has happened before is already known, and it involves humans; no one can challenge someone stronger than themselves.

verses.kjv: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
verses.decoded: Since many things add to life’s meaninglessness, how does that make humans any better off?

verses.kjv: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
verses.decoded: No one knows what is truly good for a person during their short, meaningless life, and no one can say what will happen after they die.

verses.kjv: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one’s birth.
verses.decoded: A good reputation is more valuable than expensive perfume; and the day you die is better than the day you were born.

verses.kjv: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
verses.decoded: It’s better to attend a funeral than a party, because death is the fate of everyone, and those who live will take this to heart.

verses.kjv: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
verses.decoded: Sorrow is better than laughter, because sadness can improve the heart.

verses.kjv: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
verses.decoded: Wise people focus their thoughts on serious matters like death, but fools focus on having fun and entertainment.

verses.kjv: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.decoded: It’s better to listen to criticism from a wise person than to enjoy foolish entertainment.

verses.kjv: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
verses.decoded: The laughter of a fool is like the crackling sound of thorns burning under a pot—meaningless and empty.

verses.kjv: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
verses.decoded: Oppression can drive even a wise person to madness, and a bribe can corrupt the heart.

verses.kjv: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
verses.decoded: The outcome of something is better than its start; being patient is better than being proud.

verses.kjv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
verses.decoded: Don’t be quick to get angry, because anger stays with fools.

verses.kjv: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
verses.decoded: Don’t say, 'Why were the old days better than these?' because you are not asking wisely.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is as valuable as an inheritance, and it benefits everyone who lives.

verses.kjv: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
verses.decoded: Wisdom offers protection, and money does too, but the greatest benefit of wisdom is that it gives life to those who have it.

verses.kjv: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
verses.decoded: Think about what God has done: who can make straight what He has made crooked?

verses.kjv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
verses.decoded: Be happy when things go well, but think carefully when times are hard; God has made both so that people realize there is nothing beyond this life.

verses.kjv: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
verses.decoded: I have seen everything during my meaningless life: a righteous person dies despite their goodness, and a wicked person lives long despite their evil.

verses.kjv: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?
verses.decoded: Don't try to be too righteous or too wise, or you might harm yourself.

verses.kjv: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
verses.decoded: Don't be too wicked or foolish, or you might die before your time.

verses.kjv: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
verses.decoded: It’s good to hold on to both wisdom and restraint; don’t let go of either, because those who respect God will benefit from both.

verses.kjv: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
verses.decoded: Wisdom gives more strength to the wise than having ten powerful men in the city.

verses.kjv: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
verses.decoded: There is no one on earth who is completely righteous and never sins.

verses.kjv: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
verses.decoded: Don’t pay attention to every word you hear, or you might hear your own servant curse you.

verses.kjv: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
verses.decoded: Because often your own heart knows that you have also cursed others.

verses.kjv: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
verses.decoded: I have tested all this with wisdom and said, 'I will be wise,' but true wisdom was still beyond my reach.

verses.kjv: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
verses.decoded: Who can discover what is distant and extremely deep?

verses.kjv: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
verses.decoded: I focused my mind on understanding, searching for wisdom, the reasons behind things, and the evil in foolishness and madness.

verses.kjv: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
verses.decoded: I find a woman whose heart is like traps and nets, and whose hands are like chains, to be more bitter than death. Those who please God will escape her, but sinners will be caught by her.

verses.kjv: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:
verses.decoded: Look, this is what I have discovered, says the teacher, carefully examining everything to understand it.

verses.kjv: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
verses.decoded: My soul still searches but cannot find: one good man among a thousand, but not one good woman among all of them.

verses.kjv: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
verses.decoded: Here is what I found: God made humans honest and upright, but they have invented many ways to be corrupt.

verses.kjv: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
verses.decoded: Who is as wise as a man who understands the meaning of things? Wisdom makes a person's face shine, but boldness or strength of expression can change.

verses.kjv: I counsel thee to keep the king’s commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
verses.decoded: I advise you to obey the king’s orders, especially because of the oath God has made.

verses.kjv: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
verses.decoded: Don’t rush to leave the king’s presence or stand against him in wrongdoing, because he does whatever he wants.

verses.kjv: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.decoded: A king’s command carries authority; no one can question him by saying, 'What are you doing?'

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment.
verses.decoded: Those who obey commands will avoid harm, and a wise person understands the right time and proper judgment.

verses.kjv: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
verses.decoded: Since everything has its proper time and decision, human suffering is very great.

verses.kjv: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
verses.decoded: No one knows what will happen or when it will happen.

verses.kjv: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
verses.decoded: No one can control their own spirit or stop death; there is no escape from that battle, and evil will not save those who live wickedly.

verses.kjv: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
verses.decoded: I have observed all this and considered every action done in life: there are times when one person rules over another to their own harm.

verses.kjv: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
verses.decoded: I saw wicked people buried even though they had defiled holy places, and they were forgotten in the city where they acted wickedly; this is meaningless.

verses.kjv: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.decoded: Because punishment for evil is not quick, people become bold and continue to do wrong.

verses.kjv: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
verses.decoded: Even if a sinner does evil many times and lives a long life, I am certain it will go well for those who respect and fear God.

verses.kjv: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
verses.decoded: But things will not go well for the wicked; their lives will not be extended—they are like a fleeting shadow—because they do not fear God.

verses.kjv: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
verses.decoded: It is meaningless that sometimes good people suffer as if they were wicked, and wicked people prosper as if they were good; I say this is also meaningless.

verses.kjv: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
verses.decoded: So I recommend enjoying life—eating, drinking, and being happy—because this is the best anyone can do during the days God gives them.

verses.kjv: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
verses.decoded: I focused deeply on understanding wisdom and observing everything happening on earth, because some people never rest or sleep, always watching.

verses.kjv: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
verses.decoded: I realized that no one can fully understand everything God does on earth; no matter how hard someone tries or how wise they are, they cannot figure it all out.

verses.kjv: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
verses.decoded: I thought deeply about all this and wanted to explain that the fate of the righteous, the wise, and their actions are controlled by God. No one truly understands love or hatred just by looking at what happens in life.

verses.kjv: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
verses.decoded: The same fate happens to everyone: the righteous and the wicked, the pure and the impure, those who offer sacrifices and those who do not—all face the same end. The good and the sinner, those who swear oaths and those who fear them, all share this.

verses.kjv: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
verses.decoded: This is one of the worst things in life: everyone faces the same fate. People’s hearts are full of evil and foolishness while they live, and then they die and are forgotten.

verses.kjv: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
verses.decoded: As long as you are alive, there is hope. Even a lowly living dog is better than a mighty lion that is dead.

verses.kjv: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
verses.decoded: The living understand that they will die, but the dead know nothing and receive no more rewards, and eventually people forget them.

verses.kjv: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
verses.decoded: Their feelings like love, hate, and jealousy have ended; they no longer have any share in what happens in life.

verses.kjv: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
verses.decoded: Enjoy your food and drink with happiness, because God accepts what you do now.

verses.kjv: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
verses.decoded: Keep your clothes clean and your head anointed with oil—symbols of joy and celebration.

verses.kjv: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
verses.decoded: Enjoy life with the wife you love throughout your fleeting days here on earth, because that is your share in this life and in your hard work.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
verses.decoded: Whatever work you find to do, do it with all your strength, because in death there is no work, planning, knowledge, or wisdom.

verses.kjv: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verses.decoded: I observed that success doesn’t always go to the fastest runner, the strongest warrior, the wisest person, the richest, or the most skilled. Instead, chance and timing affect everyone.

verses.kjv: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
verses.decoded: People don’t know when their time will come. Like fish caught in a net or birds trapped in a snare, humans are caught unexpectedly by disaster or death.

verses.kjv: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
verses.decoded: I also saw this wisdom in life, and it seemed impressive to me:

verses.kjv: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
verses.decoded: There was a small city with few people, and a powerful king came to attack it, surrounding it with strong defenses.

verses.kjv: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
verses.decoded: A poor but wise man was there, and he saved the city through his wisdom, but no one remembered him afterward.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
verses.decoded: I realized that wisdom is better than physical strength, but the wisdom of a poor person is often ignored and their advice is not listened to.

verses.kjv: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
verses.decoded: The advice of wise people is more effective when spoken calmly than the loud commands of a foolish ruler.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons used in battle, but a single wrongdoer can ruin a lot of good things.

verses.kjv: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
verses.decoded: Just as dead flies spoil the perfume made by a skilled worker, a little foolishness can ruin the reputation of someone known for wisdom and honor.

verses.kjv: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand; but a fool’s heart at his left.
verses.decoded: A wise person is confident and prepared, while a fool is uncertain and misguided.

verses.kjv: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
verses.decoded: Even when a fool is on the right path, his foolishness causes him to reveal himself to everyone.

verses.kjv: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
verses.decoded: If a leader becomes angry with you, don’t quit your position; being patient can calm serious conflicts.

verses.kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
verses.decoded: I have seen a serious problem on earth that comes directly from those in power.

verses.kjv: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
verses.decoded: Foolishness is often honored in high positions, while wealthy people may be humbled.

verses.kjv: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
verses.decoded: I have noticed servants riding horses while nobles walk on foot like servants.

verses.kjv: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who digs a pit will fall into it; anyone who breaks down a fence will be bitten by a snake.

verses.kjv: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
verses.decoded: Removing stones can cause injury, and chopping wood is dangerous too.

verses.kjv: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
verses.decoded: If a tool is dull and not sharpened, more effort is needed; but using wisdom helps guide actions effectively.

verses.kjv: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
verses.decoded: A snake will bite even without magic, and a person who talks too much is just as harmful.

verses.kjv: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
verses.decoded: A wise person speaks kindly, but a fool’s words cause trouble for himself.

verses.kjv: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
verses.decoded: A fool’s speech starts with nonsense and ends in harmful madness.

verses.kjv: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
verses.decoded: A fool talks too much; no one knows what will happen next, and no one can predict what comes after him.

verses.kjv: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
verses.decoded: The work of fools tires everyone because they don’t know the right way to the city.

verses.kjv: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
verses.decoded: Trouble comes to your country when your leader is immature and your officials are lazy, indulging early in the day.

verses.kjv: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
verses.decoded: Your country is fortunate when your leader is honorable and your officials eat at the right time to gain strength, not to get drunk.

verses.kjv: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.
verses.decoded: Because of laziness, the building falls apart; when people don’t work, the house collapses.

verses.kjv: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
verses.decoded: Parties bring joy and wine makes people happy, but money solves all problems.

verses.kjv: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
verses.decoded: Don’t curse the king, not even in your mind; don’t curse the wealthy when you’re alone, because your words will somehow be revealed.

verses.kjv: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
verses.decoded: Send out your resources generously, even when the outcome is uncertain, because in time you will receive a return.

verses.kjv: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Divide your investments or help among many, because you don’t know what troubles might come.

verses.kjv: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
verses.decoded: When clouds are heavy, they release rain; when a tree falls, it stays where it falls—things happen as they will.

verses.kjv: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
verses.decoded: If you wait for perfect conditions, you will never plant or harvest.

verses.kjv: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
verses.decoded: Just as you don’t understand how a baby forms in the womb, you cannot fully understand God’s plans.

verses.kjv: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
verses.decoded: Work diligently all day without hesitation, because you don’t know which efforts will succeed or if both will be good.

verses.kjv: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
verses.decoded: Light is truly good, and it’s a joy to see the sun.

verses.kjv: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
verses.decoded: If someone lives a long life and enjoys it, they should still remember the hard times, which will be many. Everything is ultimately fleeting.

verses.kjv: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
verses.decoded: Enjoy your youth and follow your desires, but remember that God will hold you accountable for your actions.

verses.kjv: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
verses.decoded: So, get rid of sadness and avoid wrongdoing, because youth and childhood are temporary.

verses.kjv: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
verses.decoded: Remember your Creator while you are young, before difficult days come and the years approach when you will find no joy in them.

verses.kjv: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
verses.decoded: Before the sun, light, moon, or stars grow dim, and before the clouds return after the rain.

verses.kjv: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
verses.decoded: When the people who take care of the house shake, strong men stoop, the grinders grow few and stop working, and those who look out the windows lose their sight.

verses.kjv: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
verses.decoded: When the doors close in the streets and the sound of grinding grain is faint, when a person wakes at the sound of a bird, and all the singers lose their voices.

verses.kjv: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
verses.decoded: When people become afraid of heights and dangers on the road, when the almond tree blooms, grasshoppers become a burden, and desire fades, because people are heading to their eternal home and mourners walk the streets.

verses.kjv: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
verses.decoded: Before the silver cord is snapped, the golden bowl is broken, the pitcher is shattered at the spring, or the wheel breaks at the well.

verses.kjv: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
verses.decoded: Then the body returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

verses.kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
verses.decoded: Meaningless! Meaningless! says the Teacher. Everything is meaningless.

verses.kjv: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
verses.decoded: Because the Teacher was wise, he taught the people knowledge, paid close attention, searched carefully, and arranged many proverbs.

verses.kjv: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
verses.decoded: The Teacher tried to find pleasing words and wrote honest, truthful sayings.

verses.kjv: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
verses.decoded: The wise words are like sharp sticks and like nails firmly fixed by leaders, coming from one source.

verses.kjv: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
verses.decoded: My son, be warned: there is no limit to writing books, and much studying tires the body.

verses.kjv: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
verses.decoded: Now let’s hear the final conclusion: Respect God and obey His commands, because this is what people are meant to do.

verses.kjv: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
verses.decoded: God will judge every action, including all hidden things, whether good or evil.
